'''Arts and culture'''
*[[2026 Écône consecrations]]
**The [[Holy See]] [[2026 SSPX excommunication|excommunicates]] the entire clergy of the [[Society of Saint Pius X]] for consecrating four [[Bishops in the Catholic Church|bishops]] yesterday without the [[Pope]]'s permission, barring the group from [[Marriage in the Catholic Church|officiating marriages]] and hearing [[Penance in the Catholic Church|confessions]].
